description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of experts and a normalized gate average value for different intent distributions. The x-axis is labeled “Experts” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Normalized Gate Average Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.20, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The line representing “Intent” is colored red and solid, starting at approximately 0.16 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 0.02 at x=64. The line representing “Summary” is colored orange and solid, starting at approximately 0.14 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 0.02 at x=64. The line representing “Law” is colored light blue and solid, starting at approximately 0.12 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at x=64. The line representing “Translation” is colored green and solid, starting at approximately 0.09 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at x=64. The line representing “Math” is colored purple and solid, starting at approximately 0.08 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at x=64. The line representing “Code” is colored gray and solid, starting at approximately 0.07 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 0.01 at x=64. Finally, the line representing “Uniform” is black and dashed, remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.00 across the entire x-axis range.
